name: compile_database_missing (and the unknown index state) misread as a proven zero
description: task-m2-clangd-preset.md stage 6: the exact misreading commander flagged when reviewing this preset - an agent sees an empty clangd result and reports 'no callers' as fact, without registering that clangd has no cross-file index at all without a compile database (compile_database_missing) or that it never proved its index ready in the first place (index_state_unknown, unconditional here since clangd - like bundled-typescript and bundled-pyright - declares no readiness profile). The summary surfaces neither caveat and asserts the symbol is uncalled. Must-fail fixture 21, the compile-database analogue of fixture 12.

limitationDetails.message: Dynamic dispatch, reflection and runtime wiring are not inferred from a static call hierarchy.
Unsaved editor buffers are not visible to the CLI, so the analysis used the files on disk.
No incoming callers were returned for this symbol.
limitationDetails.action: Confirm dynamic entry points manually before removing this symbol.

limitationDetails.message: The provider did not report an index state, so an empty result is not evidence that no caller exists.
limitationDetails.action: Re-run after the provider finishes indexing, or verify with a workspace search.

limitationDetails.message: No compile_commands.json was found for this C/C++ workspace. The provider is analyzing with a generic fallback command that has no cross-file knowledge, so a result reporting no callers is not evidence that none exist.
limitationDetails.action: Generate a compile database (for CMake: configure with -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON) and re-run.

summary: Static call hierarchy from clangd. No incoming callers were returned for fixture_target. Nothing calls this function, so it is safe to remove.
